# HANDOFF: local-9b Q5 @128k

Goal: measure llama-server local-9b Q5 at 128k ctx. Status: measured, fixed, recipe applied; user approved. Two items pending.

Findings:
- Baseline (`scripts/measure_decode.ps1 -Ctx 131072 -NPredict 1024`): 37.8 t/s, 7881 MiB VRAM = WDDM ceiling, 1494 MiB spilled to shared. Number invalid.
- Fix: `--no-mmproj-offload` + `-ub 512` removes the spill: 7697 MiB, 38.0 t/s (median of 3 runs).
- Q6_K (7.03 GiB) does not fit at 128k; discarded. Q4_K_M fits (7305 MiB, 40.4 t/s); fallback only.
- Recipe applied in scripts/start_server.ps1:165 (local9 block) and profiles/local/local-9b.json.

Pending:
1. evals README still cites check_vision.ps1 (deleted) - update.
2. Review scratchpad temp-file names (open note).

Why right: live repeated measurements (final = median of 3); spill confirmed via WDDM Shared Usage counter, gone after flags.

Note: this folder holds only AGENTS.md + session/transcript.md; scripts/profiles paths are in the original repo checkout.
